title: Accounts Clerk
description_text:
Our client, a well-established Maltese company specialising in the supply and installation of products for residential, commercial and hospitality projects, is looking for a detail-oriented and organised Accounts Clerk to join their team.
 The selected candidate will support the day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accurate financial records and providing general administrative assistance to the accounts department.
 Main Responsibilities
 Record and post accounting entries into the company's accounting system.
 Issue sales invoices, receipts and other financial documentation.
 Monitor outgoing payments, cheque payments and bank deposits.
 Perform regular bank reconciliations.
 Manage petty cash transactions and maintain accurate records.
 Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with customers regarding overdue invoices.
 Maintain accurate accounting records, documentation and filing systems.
 Assist with accounts payable and receivable activities.
 Provide general administrative support, including office supplies, equipment and insurance renewals.
 Assist with other accounting and administrative duties as required.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in an Accounts Clerk or similar accounting position.
 At least 2 years of local experience in accounting and bookkeeping.
 Good knowledge of Maltese VAT regulations and accounting procedures.
 Experience using accounting software, preferably Sage or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
 Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel.
 Strong numerical and analytical skills.
 Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
 Good organisational, documentation and filing skills.
 Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
 A qualification in accounting or a related field will be considered an asset.
 If you are organised, numerically confident and looking to develop your career within a well-established Maltese company, we would love to hear from you!
